rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: The Unfinished Rematch
card.instruction: Treat the present as another round of a contest, bargain, or failure that never reached a satisfying conclusion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we choose this year's holiday, settle who won the map argument in Cornwall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bridge was closed. Neither of us could test your shortcut.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's reopened. Let's book the same cottage and time my route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll concede it's quicker. I want to go to Spain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let me choose the airport route. Your concession needs one practical application.

card.title: The Unfinished Rematch
card.instruction: Treat the present as another round of a contest, bargain, or failure that never reached a satisfying conclusion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've set up our disputed chess position. Was my rook pinned or wasn't it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We came for dinner. I haven't played since we moved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll explain the position over starters. Then you can withdraw the cheating accusation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, you won. Pass the bread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll pass it when you say the move was legal. I can't defend my reputation with a dinner concession.

card.title: Winning Looks Natural on You
card.instruction: Treat the ease and confidence success seems to give others as both inspiring and threatening, then sharpen your need to outperform them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sold every painting without looking busy. Book me the bigger room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Start with six. I'll help you hang them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve. Show me that relaxed lean you did beside the prices.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could relax because you handled all my sales.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll handle both rooms this time. I want you to see me having enough spare breath to recommend your work.

card.title: Winning Looks Natural on You
card.instruction: Treat the ease and confidence success seems to give others as both inspiring and threatening, then sharpen your need to outperform them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How do you finish five miles looking so relaxed? I'll do six smiling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm exhausted. I just save my breath for the hill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll save enough to congratulate you at the top.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can walk it together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I'll jog ahead and find us a bench. You make recovery look easy; I could have it ready for you.

card.title: Back When I Was Ahead
card.instruction: Interpret the present through a time when you felt more successful, admired, or certain of your place.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring back the old quiz questions. I won three years running with those.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all remember the answers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it would reward loyalty as well as knowledge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You just want to win again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want the quiz to rediscover its standards.

card.title: Back When I Was Ahead
card.instruction: Interpret the present through a time when you felt more successful, admired, or certain of your place.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This old sales chart shows what I'm capable of.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's from before we sold online.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's take the website down for a fair comparison.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put your phone number on the checkout page.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put my photograph there too. In my best year people asked for me, not a basket.

card.title: Worth Keeping Around
card.instruction: Seek signs that your contribution still earns a place. Increase your effort whenever belonging feels uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've fixed your gate. Shall I come next Sunday and do the gutter?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come for lunch. My brother's doing the gutter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I'll mend those dining chairs so there's room for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's already a chair for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll check the table legs. I'd like my place here to be something you can rely on.

card.title: Worth Keeping Around
card.instruction: Seek signs that your contribution still earns a place. Increase your effort whenever belonging feels uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep me in the quiz team. I've learned every capital we missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need to justify coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll learn the currencies as a bonus.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We like your company. Come early for a drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get there before you and reserve our table. You'll always have a seat if you keep mine.

card.title: Make the Win Count
card.instruction: Treat success as meaningless unless its difficulty, sacrifice, and personal cost are fully recognized.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you announce my cake won, mention I iced it at three in the morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ribbon says first prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The ribbon got eight hours' sleep. It doesn't tell the full story.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should I mention the ingredients too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only the ones I drove across town for after midnight.

card.title: Make the Win Count
card.instruction: Treat success as meaningless unless its difficulty, sacrifice, and personal cost are fully recognized.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, we finished first. Please tell them whose weekend disappeared into that presentation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone worked hard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. My hard work includes a cancelled anniversary dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll thank your wife for lending us your weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank her for eating our anniversary dinner alone. If we're naming the team behind this win, she needs a place on it.

transfer.action: I unfold the years-old disputed score beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: This isn't new until the old point is settled. {request}
transfer.response: We've still never agreed where that coin landed. {counter}
transfer.closing: An impressively long delay for something you keep calling a small point.

transfer.action: I copy your winner's pose while presenting {prop}.
transfer.opening: I'll look that relaxed when mine is bigger. {request}
transfer.response: Watch me do it without breaking a sweat. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You're working very hard to seem relaxed.
transfer.closing: Only because I'm attempting a higher standard of effortlessness.

transfer.action: I place my best-season leaderboard beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: This is the record that tells the whole story. {request}
transfer.response: Give me the conditions that measured me properly. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then today hasn't yet received a fair chance to resemble my best year.

transfer.action: I put another completed task beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: That's another reason to keep my seat. {request}
transfer.response: I can still make myself worth the space. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You don't need to earn every place.
transfer.closing: Then let me finish this one thing while I learn to believe that.

transfer.action: I put a bandage and the sleepless-hour tally beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: The result doesn't show what it cost me. {request}
transfer.response: Read the sacrifice as well as the score. {counter}
transfer.closing: The trophy didn't give up its weekend. I'd like that part named too.
